data.name: Tejas Modi
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Tejas Modi has made a big mark in cricket. With 36 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 48*, with an average of 15.54 and a quick strike rate of 123.93. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 30 sixes and 22 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 32.0 overs, taking 17 wickets at an economy rate of 9.91. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
